title: Dragon Egg Power
description: 🐉 Dragon Egg Power turns the Dragon Egg into a legendary Minecraft artifact with effects, protection, announcements, custom recipes
body:
🐉 Dragon Egg Power Datapack

Dragon Egg Power is a Minecraft Java 1.21.11 datapack that transforms the Dragon Egg into a legendary server artifact.

✨ Features
The Dragon Egg gives the holder Glowing and Health Boost II.
Nearby enemies can trigger Mining Fatigue I.
The Dragon Egg cannot be safely stored in an Ender Chest.
If the holder dies, the server announces it with the death location.
The current holder is announced every 1 hour.
The Dragon Egg is protected from despawning.
Includes custom recipes for:
Golden Apple
Netherite Ingot
Trident
Netherite Upgrade Template
Includes an OP-only language menu for French and English.
